userId.description: Reference to users._id when the customer was logged in, or null. null rather than missing, like orders, quizResults and reviews.

name.description: Name as typed on contact.html (at least 2 characters, the form's rule).

email.description: Where to reply. Same pattern as EMAIL_PATTERN on contact.html and the checkout form.

topic.description: The Topic dropdown's values (shown as Order question, Coffee question, Account help, Feedback, Other).

orderId.description: Only for order questions: references orders.orderId (the EB-... number customers see), or null. The pattern applies only when it's a string.

message.description: Message body. 10 to 1000 characters, the same limits as the form (maxlength="1000" and its counter).

status.description: Every message starts as new; staff move it to answered, then closed.

createdAt.description: When the message was sent. A real BSON date; the browser writes an ISO string, converted at the API (see SCHEMA.md).
